abstract: 6 cases of endodermal sinus tumor of the ovary are presented. In 4 patients pure endodermal sinus tumor was found microscopically. 1 patient had endodermal sinus tumor in one ovary and gonadoblastoma in the contralateral one. In another case endodermal sinus tumor was accompanied by an embryonal teratoma. Histologically, the tumor had characteristic features with meshwork of spaces and channels lined by embryonal cells, glomerulus-like structures known as Schiller-Duval bodies, solid aggregates of epithelial cells, hyaline basement membranes and round, PAS-positive small globules found both intra- and extracellulary. In 1 patient the elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein was stated. All patients were treated surgically with adjunctive radiation and/or with chemical agents. None of them were cured. The median duration of survival amounted to 8.5 months. Discussing the value of the more recent approach to diagnostic and therapeutic methods found in the literature, it must be emphasized that the demonstration of elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein in patient with that tumor lend not only further support to its yolk sac origin but also might be useful to monitor response to the therapy applied. It is also of prognostic significance by indicating the presence of residual or recurrent disease, even in its subclinical stage. Combined postoperative irradiation and triple chemotherapy according to the VAC regimen of patients can prevent recurrence and in some cases even may cause permanent remission of the neoplasm.
abstract_ja: 卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍6例を報告する。4例では顕微鏡的に純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍が認められた。1例は一側卵巣に卵黄嚢腫瘍、対側卵巣に性腺芽腫を認めた。別の1例では卵黄嚢腫瘍に胎児性奇形腫を合併していた。組織学的には、胎児性細胞に覆われた網目状の腔と管腔構造、Schiller-Duval小体と呼ばれる糸球体様構造、上皮細胞の充実性集塊、硝子様基底膜、細胞内外に認められるPAS陽性の小球が特徴的であった。1例では血清αフェトプロテインの上昇が認められた。全例に外科的治療に加えて放射線療法および/または化学療法薬が投与されたが、治癒例はなかった。生存期間中央値は8.5か月であった。血清αフェトプロテインの上昇は、本腫瘍が卵黄嚢起源であることを支持するだけでなく、施行された治療への反応のモニタリングに有用となりうる。また、残存または再発病変（臨床的に顕在化していない段階のものを含む）の存在を示すことで予後的意義も有する。術後照射とVAC療法による3剤併用化学療法は、再発を予防し、場合によっては腫瘍の永続的寛解をもたらしうる。
